title: Answer: self-awareness extends the awareness of counterfactual alternatives

statements.text: Self-awareness is an extension of the general awareness of counterfactual alternatives: if an object can be perceived as existing independently of the rest of the world, so can oneself. How conscious one is of oneself depends on the synchronized flow of data describing oneself in the brain.

sources.quote: the notion of self-awareness could be viewed as an extension of the more general notion of awareness of counterfactual alternatives
